notes.title: Update (v1.0.0.4)
notes.notes:
Here is the list of changes brought by the new version 1.0.0.4 : 
[list]
[*] Resolved a solo bug that was displaying the wrong defeat condition to the player.
[*] Minor text corrections
[*] Adding a timer to display the waiting time when searching for a multiplayer game
[*] Adding a red button to launch the bomb
[/list]

notes.title: Nuclear Arms Race Test by Korben
notes.notes:
Korben, a well-known French blogger specializing in computer science and geek culture has tested Nuclear Arms Race. 

OfficialCH thanks him very much for his article. You can find the article (in french) on his blog at this address : [url=https://korben.info/jeu-nuclear-arms-race.html]https://korben.info/jeu-nuclear-arms-race.html[/url]

notes.title: Nuclear Arms Race is now available on Steam and Android
notes.notes:
[b]OfficialCH is pleased to announce that Nuclear Arms Race is now available for free on Steam and Android (Google Play).[/b]

The game was developed by one person with the help of a few people who kindly gave a little of their time during development. We thank them very much. 

To download the game on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.officialch.nucleararmsrace (the game should be accessible once Google allows it. We hope in the next few hours or 1 or 2 days.)  

If you want to communicate with other players or give us your feedback you can join us on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/3MnxmpD.

If you like the game and you want with extra features you can buy the DLC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1180980/Nuclear_Arms_Race__Supporter_pack/
Note that with an account you can play on both platforms (Android and Windows) note however that [u] the content of the DLC is only available on the platform on which you bought it [/u] for technical reasons. So if you buy the DLC choose your preferred platform. 

Many thanks to Raptor for making a great video presentation of the game :
[previewyoutube=81I4_4DOzB4;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=81I4_4DOzB4[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Nuclear Arms Race will be also available on Android on January 9th, 2020
notes.notes:
[b]We are pleased to announce that the game will be released on Android (Google Play) on January 9, 2020. Like Steam version it will be free! [/b] 

If you want to check the page of Nuclear Arms Race on Google Play : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.officialch.nucleararmsrace

Steam and Android players will be able to play together. Achivements are available on both platforms. You will be able to play with your account on both platforms to keep your progress. 

However the content of the DLC is only available on the platform you purchased. 

[b]A single-player mode for playing against the computer will also be available for practice.
[/b]
OfficialCH wishes you a Happy New Year 2020!

notes.title: Server disruptions possible between December 23rd and 24th
notes.notes:
You may experience some connection errors over the next couple of days (December 23rd and 24th). Corrections are currently being made and a new Steam version will be released soon. 

Thank you for your understanding.

OfficialCH wishes you a Merry Christmas !

notes.title: Nuclear Arms Race released on January 9, 2020
notes.notes:
I am proud to announce that after hard work Nuclear Arms Race will be released on Steam on January 9, 2020. It will be offered free of charge with the possibility of purchasing the "Supporter pack" dlc if you want to support me and make sure that the development of the game continues. I also hope to be able to release it in 2020 on Android. 

Feel free to join the Community Discord: https://discord.gg/3MnxmpD
